# Pixcellor™

> Pixcellor is a UK digital agency that builds bespoke, fast-loading websites and full-stack web apps for small businesses, starting from £100, with lifetime guarantee, SEO/AEO, unlimited edits and a 2-week MVP sprint option.

Pixcellor offers three packages: Full Works (£100, modern fast site with lifetime guarantee), Elite (£500, animated interactive site with unlimited edits, SEO and AEO), and Retainer (£1,200/month, ongoing tech department covering sites, apps and integrations). Services include web design, web development, app development, full-stack development, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), Web3, blockchain and AI integration.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Pixcellor overview, packages, portfolio and contact.
- [Full Works package](/packages/full-works): £150 one-off site, lifetime warranty, 3 pages, base animations.
- [Elite package](/packages/elite): £500 one-off animated site or web app, unlimited revisions, SEO/AEO, 10-day turnaround.
- [Growth Retainer](/packages/retainer-growth): £100/mo always-on web team — site, CRM, hosting, AI bots, analytics.
- [Scale Retainer](/packages/retainer-scale): £500/mo full digital department — unlimited seats, AI agents, priority SLA, monthly strategy.
- [Enterprise Retainer](/packages/retainer-enterprise): £2,500/mo fractional CTO/CMO/CRO, dedicated dev team, 2-week MVP sprints, 24/7 support.
